relevant_history_or_evidence: Pre-merge closure Project Control RED 33443463400 and 33443610633
root_cause_hypothesis: Not a runtime or closure-data defect. The accepted harness regression intentionally resolves main-owned state through origin/main. Before the closure repair is merged, origin/main still registers the P7.3 closure passport, whose merge-base predates the newly merged P7.4 runtime files. Therefore Project Control correctly reports those files as V0 CRITICAL_DEPENDENCY_DRIFT. A candidate PR cannot make this finding disappear by editing its local registry because doing so would violate main-owned-state authority.
canonical_fix_location: Merge the already-bounded control-only P7.4 closure state into main via PR #428, then perform an exact post-merge Project Control audit against the new origin/main. Do not change runtime, auditor dependency rules, watched paths, or load_main_owned semantics.
